text:
Eleanor: Thanks for joining the all-hands. Quick post-meeting thread for clarifications and small follow-ups. Recording + slides: https://drive.redwood.ai/all-hands/aug-2024.

Kai: Two quick asks from infra: 1) exact GA month for Private? 2) will we provide sample infra templates? @Eleanor

Eleanor: Targeting Oct 2024 for Private GA (tentative). Yes on templates 6 deployment guides, infra team will publish Terraform + k8s examples.

Marta: From product: can we get a short bulleted list we can hand to sales that explains Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private? Sales wanted something they can paste into a deck.

Priya: I'll draft a one-pager and share in #marketing by Tue. Hana (design) can you do a quick visual? @Marta @Priya

Ravi: Action: ops runbook for Dedicated migration coming Wed. Includes DB switchover steps and cache priming. Need an eng reviewer.

Nora: I'll review the runbook. Also can we add a tiny troubleshooting section for common failures?

Ravi: Yep will add a troubleshooting checklist.

all-hands-bot: Recording uploaded: https://zoom.redwood.ai/rec/aug24. Poll results posted in channel.

Kai: Clarify: does Dedicated autoscale accept per-model weights at GA?

Eleanor: Not at GA. Per-pool only initially; per-model weights planned post-GA. Will add to roadmap doc.

Marta: Sales question: can we surface per-model p95 latency in Console for sales to preview performance?

Priya: Product + Eng to scope a metrics card in Console. We'll aim for a minimal version that shows p95, error-rate, and cost-per-1k tokens.

Eleanor: Owners: Priya (one-pager + console metrics scope), Ravi (ops runbook + test cluster), Kai (infra templates), Nora (runbook review). Please update the follow-ups sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/d/aug-followups by EOD Fri. DM me for blockers.

Kai: Small note: infra will provision a 4-GPU test cluster for migration testing. Expect invites later today.

Marta: I'll add the sales skeleton to the sales enablement folder once Priya shares.

Priya: Draft is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/dedicated-vs-hosted. Feedback welcome.

Ravi: Demo snippet we used for canary rollout:
```
rw rollout start --pool dedicated-usw --model redwood-lite-v1 --traffic 15%
```

Eleanor: Thanks all. I'll email a short recap and close this thread. If you have extra follow-ups, add them to the sheet.
